title: Establish human plan approval gate and visible decision history APIs
task_summary: Added an explicit human plan approval gate to standing orchestrator sessions. Implemented first-class orchestrator_sessions tracking table and management endpoints. Enhanced polling loops in coordinator.py and session_runner.py to handle AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL. Exposed decision history APIs and surfaced pending approvals on the dashboard.

files_changed.change: Wrapped approve_plan with the retry decorator to prevent transient failures.
Registered orchestrator_sessions first-class tracking table and auto-migration script.
Added explicit AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL state check and handling in worker polling loops.
Enhanced _poll_until_done loop to handle AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL correctly.
Implemented start orchestrator, approve plan, get decision logs, and list aggregated project decisions endpoints.
Exposed pending_approvals_count in both get_ui_state and list_terminals endpoints to surface pending approval counts in dashboard polling.
Added comprehensive test test_orchestrator_plan_approval_and_decisions to verify the whole orchestrator plan approval and decision history endpoints.

assumptions_verified.verification: Validated successful creation and migration of orchestrator_sessions table in SQLite.
Confirmed polling loops sleep and proceed upon approval instead of timing out.

decisions.decision: Inject a dummy task for orchestrators to satisfy SQLite foreign keys
decisions.reasoning: Since session_activities has a foreign key to agent_tasks, registering a matching task row keeps schema constraints clean and satisfied.

self_review.checked: All modified files, schema changes, and test executions.

notes_for_next_step: Step 7 is fully completed and thoroughly verified. The orchestrator session, human plan approval, and visible decision history APIs are fully working.
